adjudication.rationale: In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController, both update and destroy fetch the record with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` (lines ~11–20). If no record exists, `host` is nil and `save_host(host)` calls `host.host = ...` / `host.category_id = ...`, and `destroy` calls `host.destroy`, both raising `NoMethodError` (500) instead of returning a 404. Additionally, `save_host` dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `[:category_id]` without guarding against missing `:embeddable_host`, which would also raise (500) rather than a 400.
